b_new_claims.claim: Ekspansja dynastyczna Jagiellonów ... obejmująca m.in. Czechy ięści
b_new_claims.comment: Contains a garbled non-word 'ięści' (probably a corrupted 'i Węgry'). Jagiellonian thrones in Bohemia (1471) and Hungary (1440, 1490) are real, but they came decades after Jagiełło and are not a consequence discussed within 1385–1434; as written the text is corrupted and would be penalised.

b_new_claims.claim: Unia ta zapewniła stabilność tronu i umożliwiła Polsce rolę lidera regionalnego, co trwało przez kolejne wieki.
b_new_claims.comment: Generic assertion without a fact; 'stabilność tronu' is doubtful for the period (Jagiełło's succession was secured only via privileges of Jedlnia 1430/Kraków 1433, and the Vytautas rivalry forced the Ostrów 1392 and Wilno–Radom 1401 settlements).

b_new_claims.claim: Złamanie potęgi Zakonu pozwoliło również na odzyskanie wpływów na Pomorzu i kontrolę nad szlakami handlowymi
b_new_claims.comment: Under Jagiełło, Pomerania was not regained: the First Peace of Toruń (1411) returned only the Dobrzyń Land and Samogitia (for the lifetimes of Jagiełło and Vytautas), and the Treaty of Melno (1422) settled the border without Pomerania. Gdańsk Pomerania returned only with the Second Peace of Toruń (1466), under Kazimierz Jagiellończyk.

b_new_claims.claim: ... budując silną tożsamość kulturową opartą na tradycji zachodniej.
Unia ta stworzyła fundamenty pod potęgę Jagiellonów i zapewniła Polsce bezpieczne miejsce w strukturach zachodniego chrześcijaństwa.
b_new_claims.comment: Repeats the intro. The second half is misleading: Poland had belonged to Latin Christendom since 966; Krewo brought Lithuania, not Poland, into it.

c_errors_in_both.text: Dzięki tej unii Polska zyskała ogromne terytoria na wschodzie
c_errors_in_both.correction: Overstated/incorrect. Krewo created a personal union and Lithuania stayed a separate state (the 'applicare' clause is disputed; Wilno–Radom 1401 and Horodło 1413 confirmed a separate Grand Duchy under Vytautas). Poland did not annex Lithuanian lands.

c_errors_in_both.text: Po bitwie, państwo polsko-litewskie zyskało dominację w basenie Morza Bałtyckiego
c_errors_in_both.correction: Incorrect. After Grunwald the Order kept Prussia and Gdańsk Pomerania (Toruń 1411), and Poland had no significant Baltic coastline until 1466.

c_errors_in_both.text: co pozwoliło na stabilizację granic i zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa wewnętrznego na wiele dekad
c_errors_in_both.correction: Overstated. War with the Order resumed in 1414 (Hunger War), 1422 (Melno) and 1431–1435 (ending with Brześć Kujawski 1435). There was also the Świdrygiełło conflict in Lithuania after 1430.

c_errors_in_both.text: Przyjęcie przez Jagiełłę chrztu łacińskiego oraz akt unii z Krewy były warunkiem koniecznym do wejścia Polski w krąg chrześcijańskich państw Zachodu
c_errors_in_both.correction: Incorrect. Poland had been Latin-Christian since 966. It was Lithuania that was Christianized (1386–1387, bishopric of Wilno 1387; Samogitia 1413/1417). 'Unii z Krewy' is also a wrong form ('unia w Krewie', 'akt krewski').

Overstated. The Order kept attacking Lithuania (e.g. the sieges of Wilno in 1390 and 1394) and contested Lithuania's conversion. Its crusade claims were only rebutted diplomatically at the Council of Constance (Paweł Włodkowic, 1414–1418).

c_errors_in_both.text: trwale wpisały Polskę w krąg cywilizacji zachodniej (thesis)
c_errors_in_both.correction: Misframed. Poland was already part of the Latin West. The real point is that Lithuania joined it and a Polish-Lithuanian union formed.

c_errors_in_both.text: nowoczesnej taktyki; genialnym posunięciem strategicznym; bezprecedensowy wzrost siły zbrojnej
c_errors_in_both.correction: Evaluative claims with no factual support.

Neither version uses the key concrete facts: Jadwiga and the marriage/coronation of 1386, Ostrów 1392, Wilno–Radom 1401, Horodło 1413, Toruń 1411, Melno 1422, Constance/Włodkowic, the 1400 renewal of the Kraków Academy, or the privileges of Jedlnia and Kraków.

summary: Pairs: 17/17 faithful, 0 lost_content, 0 invented_content. No invented text and no deleted essay prose in any pair; removals were only preambles, 'Temat nr 1' headers, standalone aspect headings, a plan block, a word-count note, a grader comment, an offer, JSON syntax and whitespace. In every heading-removal pair the aspect is still identifiable from its paragraph and named in the conclusion. For P04 (political), P07 (territorial/political) and P10 (educational) the paragraph names it only implicitly. Minor incomplete cleanup: an inline 'Zakończenie:' label stays in P06, P07 and P10, and inline 'Teza:' stays in P03 and P04. P09's 'Oto jeden z najważniejszych okresów...' is prose and was correctly kept. Repair delta: B adds about 67 words of mostly filler with no correct concrete fact. New errors: a false claim that Pomerania was regained under Jagiełło (it returned in 1466) and a garbled token 'Czechy ięści'. One sentence became ungrammatical ('połączonych z aktem unii'), and only two typos were fixed. A's errors all remain: Baltic 'dominance' after Grunwald, annexation of 'ogromne terytoria', Poland 'entering' Latin Christendom through Krewo, 'protection from crusades', and 'stabilised borders for decades'.
